build: 0.1.4 release working tree, captured before the final release commit
sourceTreeHashScope: Sorted current desktop/core src files, their package files, root package and lockfile, bundled CHANGELOG, icon and native floating-monitor window definition; raw file SHA256 values and paths are NUL-delimited.
source: Current real App imported through apps/desktop/src/main.tsx; original production CSS order.
scope: Isolated in-memory documentation data only. No real inference, service, credentials, installation, update or operating-system change. Models, configurations, conversations, reports, hardware, status and metrics are synthetic.

coverProvenance.type: Complete Overview screenshot with service-status popover open
coverProvenance.scope: Overview promotion screenshots, isolated synthetic in-memory RPC, model and hardware values. No actual inference, service, credentials, installer, updater or operating-system change.
coverProvenance.note: The complete viewport is preserved without cropping or composition. Values are isolated demonstration data. product-cover.webp is byte-identical to the English screenshot.

historicalCoverProvenance.kind: Bilingual product hero: existing generated abstract background, deterministic text and current real interface screenshots
historicalCoverProvenance.note: Interface data is synthetic. Covers use quality-95 WebP compression; pixel-identical lossless claims apply only to the 36 original page images. product-cover.webp is the English alias.

dailyExperienceUnreleased.source: Real App components via daily-experience-app.html; API usage is a standalone real ApiUsagePage fixture.
dailyExperienceUnreleased.scope: Synthetic in-memory native data, service capabilities, SSE answers, history, GPU/RAM and statistics. No real model, supervisor, credentials, installer, updater, benchmark or OS mutation.
dailyExperienceUnreleased.imageScope: 16 light-theme screenshots: the four model-download list/detail images use a real 1440x1200 viewport so the resource card fits above the footer; the other twelve use 1440x960. Separate 800px QA covers each scene in Chinese/English and light/dark. API usage retains the standalone fixture toolbar and is not a whole-App screenshot.

alternateViewports.reason: The 960px-height viewport clips resource-guidance figures behind the fixed download footer. A real taller viewport preserves the complete actual component without CSS/DOM changes.

sourceProvenance.hashScope: All files under apps/desktop/src, packages/core/src, desktop native src/capabilities, plus the current CHANGELOG.md read by App, package/lock/config files; tracked and untracked files included. Helpers independently hashed. Paths and raw-file SHA256 values sorted and NUL-delimited.
